questions.prompt: A model is perfect on its training data but poor on new data. This suggests...
options: That the test data are useless
questions.explanation: Overfitting means learning training examples without generalizing well.

questions.prompt: Why can a spam filter fail when spammers change tactics?
questions.explanation: Deployment inputs can differ from training inputs.

questions.prompt: What is an example of prompt injection?
options: A genuine user asks for help
An attacker plants instructions in a webpage the assistant is reading
A student trains a model on examples
An AI assistant summarizes a trusted article
questions.explanation: Prompt injection happens when attacker-controlled lower-trust content tries to redirect the assistant.

questions.prompt: A model fails on an email; you suspect the word "free" caused it. What is that explanation?
questions.explanation: An observation is not proof of its cause; we need an experiment to test the hypothesis.
